3pm.index: own 3-point shot mix against the opponent's 3-point allowance (corner and above the break)

ast.index: own assist-location mix against the opponent's assists allowed by location

pts.index: the opponent's field-goal attempts allowed per 48 and field-goal points allowed per attempt, each against the league (data/team_allowance.json)

reb.index: misses per 48 in the opponent's games against the league (data/team_allowance.json)
